critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage cylinder geometry to include two distinct horizontal window rows instead of one. Set the primary row at a 15-degree upward tilt from the midline and add a secondary upper row 0.8m above it. For each row, replace the uniform dot pattern with a repeating rectangular primitive array (length: 2.4m, height: 0.6m) spaced every 1.2m along the cylinder's longitudinal axis, excluding the area occupied by the main cabin door seams.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck).

discrepancies.observed: No visible window structure on the forward hump area.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent row of windows following the curve of the upper deck.

discrepancies.observed: Smooth fuselage surface with no breaks or recessed lines for doors.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular outlines and seams for main cabin doors.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length of the cylinder.
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with specific clusters around door locations.
